Maintenance 
 Procedures P1 depend on external / internal leakage

This document
 outlines the maintenance procedures P1 of main steam stop valve, depend 
 on external or internal leakage.

This valve is used for feed the water to the drum and de-superheat the main 
 steam.

Low capacity feed water control valve

sections.text:
Inspect and Repair of all 
 parts

Check the body from any cracks or wear by using penetration 
 fluids and repair it if needed.
Check the seat ring and regrind it if needed.
Check the spindle and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the flex. gaskets and change it if needed.
Check the bushing (17) and repair it if needed or replace it.
Check the packing and change it if needed.

 إصلاحه إذا لزم الأمر أو استبداله.
